what: Master Version 2.47 — Lionel MPC-Modern gets a new last column "UPC / Barcode" (after Row ID) and 1,980 cells (1,978 items) filled with the item's Lionel box barcode as published by Trainz.com on its NEW-stock listing pages. Every barcode: 12 digits, Lionel prefix 023922, correct check digit; the listing title names exactly one of our items (no sets, no part numbers). Two item numbers with two rows each that are the same item (2229170, 2326181) get the barcode on both rows; four with a second, different item filed under the same number get it only on the row whose description is Trainz's item (2034190 BN GP38, 2138070 Chester A. Arthur, 2428100 Weather Balloon Defense, 2429130 John Deere Barn). Nothing else changes.
